description: This Java source file defines the CommandNotSupportedException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a command is not supported by a specific API version. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing exceptions.

classes.name: CommandNotSupportedException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception thrown when a command is not supported by the called API version.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing CommandNotSupportedException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance for constructing CommandNotSupportedException, given a version number.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a CommandNotSupportedException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a CommandNotSupportedException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
